ceiling: Configuration validation only, so it confirms the format and lint commands and the autofix setting are declared; it does not show the sources are formatted or lint-clean.
offer: Reuse the component-owned formatter and lint tasks. Read-only verification must preserve source bytes; invoke autofix only under a separately approved action.

minimal.reason: Declare the component's own formatter command. Without it formatting cannot be verified read-only, so reuse the repository's existing task.

mid.reason: Declare the component's own lint command. A missing command leaves lint unchecked, so reuse the repository's existing task.

maximal.reason: Set autofix during a check to false. A check that rewrites source breaks the read-only guarantee, so run autofix only under a separate approved action.

rule.reason: Declare the component's own formatter command. Without it formatting cannot be verified read-only, so reuse the repository's existing task.
